svg.text: A cross-section at the child's size (about ×85,000): a green cathedral of cells under a glass roof
Round cells around the air cave
air in; water escapes as mist
blue drops; pale blue mist when it escapes
a grey puff, dark core, two red dots
a chloroplast, glowing when it works
wrinkled and pale: the leaf droops
blue brings water, gold takes sugar
